meta.title: HUSTIN BÂTIMENT — Reinforced-concrete structural works, French Riviera
meta.desc: HUSTIN BÂTIMENT, general structural-works contractor based in Biot. Exceptional villas, major structural renovations and complex reinforced-concrete works on the French Riviera, for discerning architects and private clients.

maison.label: The house
maison.p1: Éric Hustin, founding president, has spent more than thirty years on the Riviera’s reinforced-concrete sites, earning a solid reputation among architects. Louis Hustin, managing director, embodies the next generation.
maison.p2: Every structure carries the family name. That is binding: a word kept, deadlines met, workmanship that stands up to close inspection. Such is the character of the firm — closer to a family home than to a building company.
maison.p3: HUSTIN BÂTIMENT is a member of Les Idéas, a Cannes entrepreneurs’ circle attached to the Villa Romée.
maison.alt: Louis and Éric Hustin on site
savoir.label: Expertise
savoir.titre: Four crafts, one standard of excellence.
savoir.m1d: Complete reinforced-concrete structural works — foundations, shear walls, floor slabs, pools — carried out hand in hand with architects, from execution drawings to handover.
savoir.m2d: Extensions, full basements, covered excavation and underpinning: the heavy interventions that demand method and the utmost care.
savoir.m3d: Infrastructure, foundations and slabs for industrial programmes, executed with the same rigour as our residential work.
savoir.m4d: Sawing of any thickness and the creation of openings, indoors or in façades, with a method and structural precautions tailored to each case.
savoir.archiText: Patterned or architectural walls, raw board-formed concrete left exposed: specialist skills placed at the service of architects who wish to make concrete a visible material.
savoir.bandCap: Raising the floor slabs — tower crane dedicated to the site
savoir.bandAlt: Aerial view of a HUSTIN BÂTIMENT site — floor slabs raised by tower crane
real.label: Portfolio
proj.hb2401.desc: Complete structural works for a 700 m² contemporary villa in the hills above Cannes: foundations, board-formed concrete walls, long-span floor slabs and a pool. A project led in close partnership with the architect, delivered in 2024 on schedule.
proj.hb2401.cap1: Aerial view — lifting by tower crane
proj.hb2401.cap2: Sawing and finishing on the roof terrace
proj.hb2602.titre: Contemporary villa, 700 m² — existing structure retained
proj.hb2602.desc: A second large-scale project in Cannes: a 700 m² contemporary villa preserving part of the existing structure. Earthworks, underpinning, a complete substructure and then the reinforced-concrete superstructure — with a tower crane dedicated to the site.
proj.hb2602.cap1: Aerial view — raising the floor slabs
proj.hb2602.cap3: Walls and columns at garden level
proj.hb2303.desc: A 400 m² modern house of Californian inspiration in Mandelieu: horizontal lines, cantilevered canopies and expansive glazing. Precision formwork in the service of a refined geometry, up to the planted roof.
proj.hb2504.desc: Creating a ten-metre-long opening in a load-bearing wall: shoring, underpinning, heavy-section concrete sawing, then the installation of reinforcements. A major intervention, executed without the slightest disturbance to the existing structure.
proj.hb2205.desc: A cantilevered pool for a high-end villa in Cannes: a reinforced-concrete basin partially suspended above terraced grounds. Reinforcement detailing, heavy shoring and the structural watertightness of the concrete itself.
proj.hb2205.cap1: Concrete structure and shoring of the basin
proj.hb2205.cap2: The basin within its terraced grounds
proj.hb2506.desc: Major renovation of a Cap d’Antibes property: an extension, a full basement created by covered excavation and the underpinning of the existing foundations. The working method behind the house’s most technical projects.
proj.hb2506.cap2: Éric & Louis Hustin — a project followed end to end

eng.label: Commitments
eng.1t: A ten-year warranty never once invoked
eng.1d: In more than twenty years of practice, our ten-year structural warranty has never been called upon. To us, it is the only statistic that matters.
eng.2d: Precise formwork, clean finishes, well-kept sites. The care given to what will be covered equals the care given to what will remain visible.
eng.3d: From the first meeting to handover, you speak to the same person — someone who knows your file, your land and your deadlines.

avis.label: Reviews & questions
avis.3: Professionalism and availability! Nothing but satisfied clients!
faq.q1: Do you work only on the French Riviera?
faq.a1: We work mainly in the Alpes-Maritimes, across four areas: Cannes, Mougins and Valbonne · Cap d’Antibes · Nice, Èze, Villefranche-sur-Mer and Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat · Mandelieu and Théoule-sur-Mer.
faq.q2: Do you create openings in load-bearing walls?
faq.a2: Yes. Concrete sawing of any thickness and the creation of openings, indoors or in façades. Every intervention follows a tailored method with appropriate structural precautions — shoring, underpinning, reinforcement.
faq.q3: Can you lead a major renovation with a basement?
faq.a3: Yes. Extensions, the creation of a full basement by covered excavation, underpinning of existing foundations. The working method is defined by the constraints of the site and the existing structure.
faq.a4: Yes — most of our projects are carried out in close partnership with the Riviera’s architects: study of execution drawings, bespoke architectural concrete, refined finishes.
faq.q5: How does a quotation request proceed?
faq.a5: A call or a message, a site visit, then a detailed, item-by-item estimate. You receive a first reply within 24 hours.
